scoreReasons: All checkout, Delegate Payment, webhook and feed traffic is bilateral HTTPS between agent, merchant and PSP; nothing is written to a public ledger.
The only standard public artifact per seller is the optional /.well-known/acp.json discovery document, which lists versions, transports and services but no volume.
There is no public registry or explorer of ACP merchants or agents, and the ACP site says discovery mechanisms were still being developed.
The project is transparent about the spec: the GitHub repository shows commits, SEPs, the CLA list and governance.
No official transaction volume, GMV or merchant count has been published.

public.how: Unauthenticated GET; protocol.version, supported_versions, api_base_url, transports, capabilities.services; cacheable for at least an hour.
Commits, pull requests, SEPs, changelog files, MAINTAINERS.md and legal/cla/SIGNATORIES.md.
